localizedDescriptions.en: Home-screen widgets for Vibe Usage: track AI coding token usage, estimated cost, active time and cache ratio, with small, medium and large layouts, offline cache, dark and light themes, English and Chinese, and per-widget parameter presets such as {"view":"models","days":30}.
localizedDescriptions.zh: Vibe Usage 桌面小组件：追踪 AI 编程 Token 用量、预估费用、活跃时长与缓存占比。支持小、中、大三种尺寸、离线缓存、深浅色主题、中英双语，并可通过 Parameter 预设（如 {"view":"models","days":30}）为每个小组件独立配置。
